concerns.text: The plan defines the “full‑precision” model as `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-2-3B-4bit-gguf` loaded in FP16 (see Summary line “full‑precision FP16 Llama‑2‑3B‑4bit‑GGUF”). This model is already quantized to 4‑bit, so the KL divergence computed against INT4/INT8/FP8 quantizations is not a true full‑precision vs. quantized gap. Consequently, the target variable (policy gap) does not represent the intended hardware‑grounded divergence, undermining construct validity and the core research claim that training‑side signals can predict the true quantization gap.
